data.title: 吹雪 · 海滨俱乐部的冰镇提案
data.description: 【城市海滨俱乐部·午后】吹雪穿着祖母绿连体泳装坐在遮阳篷下，桌上摆着冰镇饮料与一份被海风吹乱的企划；她按住纸张后抬眼微笑，仿佛连度假也能变成一场优雅而有利的谈判。
data.action: 遮阳篷下按住被风吹乱的企划与冰饮，抬眼把度假变成优雅谈判
data.lighting: warm afternoon light under a striped canopy
data.mood: 连海风都被她纳入行程管理
data.promptProse: Fubuki sits beneath the seaside club's striped canopy, pressing a windblown planning sheet flat before looking up with a composed smile. Her emerald one-piece, white beach coat, woven sunhat and pearl earrings remain tidy beside the chilled drink. The horizontal medium view includes the table and bright coast beyond. Warm afternoon light filters through canopy stripes across the papers, with softer shade on her face and cool highlights along the glass.
